summary: v75 testing: Criteria master library (items/sets), live-tender criteria editing (no bids editable / bids locked), modal 'Add from master' (sets + items), Save as set, New notice auto-opening Criteria modal, Publish checklist Publish button, RBAC/CSRF, builder regressions. Backend 20/20 pytest pass (run with -n 0; the module fixture is not xdist-safe). All 7 requested features pass in the UI. No critical bugs. A few minor security/UX notes below.

minor.issue: Anonymous request returns 200 with the full master library, sets included. GET /api/v1/criteria-library correctly returns 401 for the same data, so the auth rule is inconsistent and admin-built sets leak to the public. The anonymous call also triggers _seed().

issues: The '+ Add from master…' select uses inp (w-full) plus w-auto, and w-full wins. So 'Read from tender document (AI)', the dropdown and '+ Blank criterion' each sit on their own row instead of one toolbar row.
The 'Remove' link on master rows and set cards archives straight away, with no confirmation. One misclick removes a master criterion.
Rows are sorted by title, so a newly added criterion moves to a different position after saving.

Draft rows show two Publish buttons. The row-level PUBLISH is always enabled; the checklist Publish is disabled until all three checks pass. If a check fails, the row button gives a backend 409. Consider hiding or disabling the row button with the same rule.
The section heading 'Published notices — visible on the public board' also appears above draft rows (existing issue).
Adding the same set or master item twice silently creates duplicate rows (no dedupe or warning).

action_items: Require login on GET /api/v1/tender-criteria/templates (it is used only inside logged-in builders and modals), or strip sets from the anonymous response, to match criteria-library's 401.
Fix the criteria-template select width (drop w-full or use a separate class) so the toolbar stays on one row.
Add a confirm step before archiving a master criterion or set.
Optional: disable or hide the row-level PUBLISH on drafts when the checklist is not ready; dedupe rows when adding from master.
critical_code_review_comments: tender_criteria.templates() has no auth dependency, while criteria_library.get_library calls tender_principal (401). Same data, different gates.
save_criteria on a live tender has a race: _live_bids is checked and then _store runs, so a bid arriving in between could see criteria change mid-submission. Low risk.
Changing criteria on a live tender with no bids sends no corrigendum or notification to watchers. Product decision to confirm.
_live_bids excludes only 'withdrawn' and 'rejected'. If draft or in-progress bid states are added later, they will lock criteria.
seed_data_creation: None kept. Created and then deleted: TEST_ master item, TEST_ sets (UI + API), notice PMC-NOT-2026-0082 'TEST_ UI checklist notice' (published via checklist, then deleted), and 2 cloned tender_templates (admin + vendor, 'Standard PSU ... draft 2026-11-01'). DEMO-TND-001 tender_criteria restored to [] (verified).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the v75 test with `pytest -n 0` because pytest.ini enables xdist and the module teardown deletes TEST_ sets across workers. DEMO-TND-001/002/003 have no bids (editable while live); DEMO-TND-OPEN (2 bids) and DEMO-TND-AWD (1 bid) are locked (409). Creating a notice in the UI: fill the deadline last (a stale-state setDraft from an earlier field wipes it otherwise), and the primary upload rejects files under a few KB. For checklist testing the primary_document was set via mongo.
